font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<div style=\"font-size:0\"><span style=\"font-size:14px\">restored and visible</span></div>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
